story: One pulse, many rooms. Each channel is a tempo, not a genre: whatever is playing, your body already knows the beat. A Bill Evans ballad and a dub plate can share 80 BPM; an acid line and a Bach allegro felt at double time can share 128; jungle and fast bluegrass picking both run at 170. We pick the tracks like a selector does, by feel, so you can drop in any time and just move.

taste.about: Chris's taste, from his liked music (acid / 303, Charlotte de Witte and Amelie Lens techno, Portishead, Wu-Tang / Nas / Cypress Hill, Bob Marley and roots reggae, Bill Evans / Miles Davis / Takuya Kuroda jazz, Bach / Mozart / Schubert / Rachmaninoff / Philip Glass) and his club notes (UK garage tempo and acid house first; Introspekt's 128-175 BPM spread; live hardware sets; dub techno; no gabber or hardstyle). Weights 0-1 lift a track's score; avoided tags drop it.

residents.about: What the dance server plays: rooms held by a resident DJ, always playing, with a daily set on the schedule. publish.mjs builds only these; the channels below are the pools the tracks come from (ccmixter-shortlist.mjs).

list.setInfo: Acid lines, 303 squelch, minimal and electro at 120 to 134 BPM. On the schedule every day, and the room keeps the mix going around the clock, so drop in any time.
list.bio: The house selector of Dance With Me: Creative Commons acid and techno picked by ear for moving to. Music credits are in the room menu.

channels.name: Morning Coffee
channels.story: Slow pulse for the first move of the day: jazz piano, a string quartet, dub, trip-hop. Bill Evans and Portishead in the same room, at the same heartbeat.

channels.name: Boom Bap Yard
channels.story: Head-nod tempo. Golden-era hip hop, roots reggae and funk share a swing, and jungle sits here too at half time.

channels.name: Kiosk Afternoon
channels.story: A daytime floor by the water: deep house, disco, latin and swing. Easy to step into, hard to leave.

channels.name: Acid Axis
channels.story: The 303 tempo. Acid, techno and electro, with an orchestral piece or a fast baroque line felt at double time slipping in between.

channels.name: Two-Step & Strings
channels.story: Garage swing, breaks and half-step dubstep, and bluegrass fiddle tunes at the same canter.

channels.name: Pressure
channels.story: Introspekt's top end: jungle, drum & bass and footwork, next to banjo breakdowns and bebop-fast swing.
